title: Tupelo Honey Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Tupelo Honey is a new Seaside favorite, located directly across from the beach and featuring a private tower with sweeping Gulf and sunset views. Has four king bedrooms and prime Seaside location directly across from the beach!
description_expanded: Description14 TUPELO STREET4 KINGS, 2 SETS OF BUNKS (full/full in bonus bunk room) - Sleeps 12 Prime Gulf-Front Location on Tupelo StreetPerfectly positioned just 69 feet from Seaside’s iconic Tupelo Pavilion beach access, Tupelo Honey offers one of the most sought-after locations in Seaside, Florida. Situated directly across from the Gulf and only one block from the heart of town, this exceptional coastal home places you within a five-minute walk of more than 40 Seaside shops, restaurants, and landmarks. From sunrise strolls along the sugar-white sand to evenings spent enjoying concerts at the Seaside Amphitheater, every classic Seaside experience is effortlessly close.Outdoor Living Designed for Coastal RelaxationSurrounded by lush landscaping and a fenced yard, Tupelo Honey invites guests to enjoy the outdoors from every angle. The home features four breezy porches and a showstopping open-air rooftop tower deck with sweeping Gulf views that stretch to the horizon. Private parking is conveniently located directly in front of the home. Begin your mornings on the screened front porch, where rocking chairs and a charming bench swing create the perfect place to enjoy coffee, salty breezes, and the soothing sound of waves just across the street.Open-Concept Living for Gathering and EntertainingInside, the home opens to a bright and spacious open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area—designed for easy coastal living and effortless entertaining. The fully equipped kitchen features a center island with a four-burner cooktop, breakfast-bar seating for four, a full-size refrigerator, microwave, and everything needed for preparing meals at home. The adjacent dining area seats eight comfortably, ideal for family dinners, game nights, or post-beach gatherings. The inviting living room offers a sofa, swivel chairs, and direct access to a covered side porch with chaise loungers and yard views—perfect for evening relaxation.Flexible Spaces for Family and GuestsJust off the kitchen, a tucked-away bunk room is seperated by a barn door and includes two double bunk beds, providing a fun retreat for younger guests or extra sleepers. Down the hall, a secondary living area offers additional seating with a plush sofa, club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV, creating a cozy space for movie nights or quiet afternoons. This area opens onto another covered porch with seating for two and convenient access to the outdoor shower. The first king bedroom is off the living room seperated by a sliding barn door and features a large dresser and front porch access. Comfortable King Suites & Upper-Level PorchUpstairs, three additional well-appointed king bedrooms offer peaceful retreats after a day at the beach. The second king suite features a flat-screen TV, dresser, closet space, and an en-suite bathroom with a tub/shower combination. The third king bedroom just down the hallway provides fresh coastal style and ample room to unwind with a small built in closet and views to the center shared porch. The open air upper porch has cushioned loungers that connects the level offering treetop views, coastal breezes, and the sounds of the waves directly across the street. The fourth king suite, located at the rear of the home, includes a flat-screen TV, dresser, closet space, and a private bathroom with dual vanities and a tub/shower combination. Rooftop Tower with Panoramic Gulf ViewsThe crown jewel of Tupelo Honey awaits at the top of the home. A full staircase leads to the third-floor rooftop tower deck, trellis-covered and furnished with Adirondack seating for five. From this elevated perch, enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico—an unforgettable backdrop for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, and evenings under the stars. This serene retreat captures the true magic of Seaside living and leaves a lasting impression long after your stay.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 2,431 square feet69 feet or a one-minute walk to beach access at Tupelo Pavilion, largest private residential beaches on 30A Outdoor charcoal grillOutdoor showerLaundry room with full-size washer and dryerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis and 3 Pickle ball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes are issued; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
